heading.title: First Division · Part II · Suits Relating to Contracts

article.title: Three years.
article.content:
Article49Three years.

The Schedule  ·  First Division—Suits · Part II—Suits Relating to Contracts
By a co-trustee to enforce against the estate of a deceased trustee a claim for contribution.
Period of limitationThree years.

Time from which period begins to runWhen the right to contribution accrues.
